_readme: Automations for THIS client instance. The AiCIV edits this file; there is no admin editor.
After editing: cd <instance>/app && python3 manage.py sync-workflows   (validates, then loads; a bad file is refused).
It is also loaded at every app start (a bad file is logged and the previous definitions are kept).
trigger.type: form_submitted (forms: contact | subscriber | order | appointment; [] = any) or tag_added (tag_name).
once_per_contact (default true): a contact never gets the same workflow twice.
steps[].action: send_email (template: an id under templates) | add_tag | remove_tag (tag_name).
steps[].delay: wait before this step, counted from the PREVIOUS step (first step: from enrollment). 0, 30m, 2h, 3d.
status: active | paused. Removing a workflow from this file archives it (its enrollments stop).
Merge fields in subject/body_html: {{first_name}} ('there' if unknown), {{last_name}}, {{email}}, {{business_name}}. Visitor values are HTML-escaped.
Every email gets the business footer + a working one-click unsubscribe link automatically.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.subject: Thanks for reaching out to {{business_name}}
welcome.body_html:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thanks for getting in touch with {{business_name}}. We got your message and will reply personally soon, usually within one business day.

In the meantime, just reply to this email if there is anything you want to add.

Talk soon,
The {{business_name}} team

follow-up.name: Follow-up (+2 days)
follow-up.subject: Any questions, {{first_name}}?
follow-up.body_html:
Hi {{first_name}},

Just checking in. Did you have any questions we can answer about working with {{business_name}}?

Reply to this email and a real person will get back to you.

The {{business_name}} team

value.name: Value (+7 days)
value.subject: What our clients love about {{business_name}}
value.body_html:
Hi {{first_name}},

Here is what our clients tell us they value most about {{business_name}}:

  1. We respond fast and personally.
  2. We make the process simple.
  3. We follow through on what we promise.

Whenever you are ready, reply to this email and we will take it from there.

The {{business_name}} team

workflows.name: New lead welcome sequence
workflows.description: Welcome right away, a check-in 2 days later, a value email 7 days after the first contact.
